description: Returns only bounded facts about the caller identity supplied by the bridge. It never returns a stable session key.
embedding_description: Qualify caller identity facts supplied by the bridge for this process invocation without exposing a stable session key or routing credential. The result distinguishes a currently registered bridge from one-shot attribution and an unavailable identity, so setup and doctor checks can prove identity presence without treating peer enumeration or a guessed endpoint as identity evidence.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: caller_identity_available, registered_bridge, and a safe bridge identity category.
